children: Consumer electronics company boAt Lifestyle has appointed Saikat Mukhopadhyay as Group Chief Financial Officer, effective September 2026. He will be based in Mumbai.

Mukhopadhyay joins boAt from logistics technology platform WheelsEye, where he served as Group CFO from March 2024 to August 2026. His responsibilities included financial management, governance and capital strategy.

Before WheelsEye, Mukhopadhyay was CFO at BirlaNu from June 2022 to October 2023, overseeing strategic business units in India, Germany and Austria. He previously served as CFO of Somany Ceramics from January 2018 to June 2022.
He also held the position of Group Financial Controller at CNH Industrial from February 2016 to January 2018.
Mukhopadhyay is a Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and holds an MBA in marketing and finance from XLRI Jamshedpur.
He announced his appointment in a LinkedIn post, stating, “I'm happy to share that I'm starting a new position as Chief Financial Officer at boAt Lifestyle!”
